segments.text:
V. 5.
They will not follow a ſtranger—One whom Chriſt hath not ſent, who doth not anſwer the preceding Deſcription. Him they will not follow—And who can conſtrain them to it? But will ſee from him—As from the Plague. For they know not the voice of strangers—They reliſh it; it is harſh and grating to them. They find nothing of GOD therein.
